# From Timely Comics to Marvel

Marvel Comics began in 1939 as Timely Comics, founded by publisher Martin Goodman. Its first comic, Marvel Comics #1, introduced the Human Torch and Namor the Sub-Mariner.

In 1941 Timely published Captain America Comics #1, created by Joe Simon and Jack Kirby. The cover showed Captain America punching Adolf Hitler, months before the United States entered the Second World War.

The company was later known as Atlas Comics, and took the Marvel name in the early 1960s. The turning point was The Fantastic Four #1 in 1961, by Stan Lee and Jack Kirby, which started the Marvel Age of comics.
